Chunk 4 line 32 'The running game' -> chunk 0/1; 'the test suite' -> chunk 2 line 17; 'the commit history' -> chunk 2 line 18 / chunk 0 line 5; 'the one bug you spotted while playing' -> chunk 1 line 13. No never-named or stranded referent found.

Exactly two cross-document references in the current body. Chunk 3 line 23: '[prework](../prework.md)' -- named by link text, no page-position language. Chunk 2 line 19 flag:module branch: 'Module 3' -- named by its stable module number, the same convention this file itself uses for its own module ('your Module 1 material' line 9, 'your Module 1 bug' line 13, '## Bring to Module 1' line 30), not a positional locator.
